display.purpose: Content-page headings (.section__heading) and the compact header's page title (.hero__pagetitle h1) — weight 900 with 'SOFT' 40, 'WONK' 1 variation. Headings-only face; never body/label/UI.

numeral.purpose: Agenda page's giant tabular-numeral day-of-month figures (16/17/18); Past FACTs' year figures reuse the same device at a smaller scale (clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem)).

title.purpose: Landing page's TOC entry titles, weight 800; Workshops session titles (.workshop__title) reuse the same weight/family one step below Display.

category-label.purpose: FAQ category headings (.faq__categoryheading), weight 700, set in --accent-on-light. As of the Workshops/Team/Past-FACTs pass, the identical visual spec is also served by a new generic class, .groupheading, used for Workshop session headings and Team committee headings. Both class names exist for the same computed style — a documented minor duplication, not two patterns.

quote.purpose: About page's pulled quote; Past FACTs theme names (.pastfacts__theme) reuse the same italic Fraunces device for a pulled-phrase feel.

lead.purpose: About page's opening sentence, weight 400, ink-900.

body.purpose: About paragraph copy and FAQ answers, set in --ink-on-light-dim; Workshops session descriptions (.workshop__desc) reuse the same dim-ink body treatment.

structural-label.purpose: Agenda weekday labels, TOC index numerals, cross-link strip label, set in --accent-on-light; Workshops 'spots left' tags (.workshop__spots) and Team role labels (.team__role) reuse the same uppercase compact-label device.

nav-link.purpose: Primary nav items across all six pages. Font-size reduced from 0.95rem to 0.92rem and link gap tightened to fit six links (About Us/Agenda/Workshops/Team/Past FACTs/FAQ) inline.

meta.purpose: Night-band topbar eventline and countdown label, unchanged.

shadows.name: footer-mark-shadow
shadows.purpose: Footer's circular photo mark — the one carried-over ambient shadow on the day band's dark bookend.

shadows.name: placeholder-circle-shadow
shadows.purpose: Shared shadow on the radial-gradient placeholder circle device: Team member avatars (.team__avatar) and Past FACTs photo placeholders (.pastfacts__photo) both reuse this exact value.

shadows.name: pill-ink-shadow
shadows.purpose: New .pill--ink variant's resting shadow — soft and diffuse, matching the system's no-hard-offset rule.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover/focus transitions across both bands.

breakpoints.name: mobile-nav
breakpoints.purpose: Nav collapses to hamburger. Moved from 780px in the Workshops/Team/Past-FACTs pass to give the now six-link, still-inline nav more room before collapsing. Also: About/Agenda grids collapse to one column; the four corner motifs switch to fixed mobile pixel sizes; Workshops rows stack to a single column; Past FACTs entries top-align and shrink their photo circle from 110px to 76px.

breakpoints.name: topbar-wrap
breakpoints.purpose: Night band: topbar eventline wraps. Unchanged.

breakpoints.name: faq-compact
breakpoints.purpose: FAQ summary shrinks; TOC arrow hides and entries top-align; cross-link strip stacks vertically.

components.name: Content Section Heading
components.description: Load-bearing heading pattern on every page: a Fraunces 900 heading (SOFT 40/WONK 1) with a short orchid accent rule beneath it. Reused verbatim by Workshops, Team, and Past FACTs.
components.css: .ds-section-inner { max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; } .ds-section-heading { margin: 0; font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 900; font-variation-settings: 'SOFT' 40, 'WONK' 1; font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5.5vw, 4rem); line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #0e155e; } .ds-section-rule { width: 64px; height: 2px; margin: 1.5rem 0 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #b37ad4, rgba(179,122,212,0)); }

components.name: Group Heading (Workshops sessions, Team committees)
components.description: New generic class (.groupheading) for a subheading pattern that groups related entries — Workshop session names, Team committee names. Visually and numerically identical to the pre-existing .faq__categoryheading; both class names currently exist in sections.css for the same computed style. Documented as a known duplication, not a two-pattern system.
components.css: .ds-groupheading { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 1.9vw, 1.5rem); letter-spacing: -0.005em; color: #4b1c71; }

components.name: Pill — Ink variant
components.description: New third pill variant for interactive buttons placed directly on the parchment day band (Workshops 'Register', Past FACTs 'View Booklet'). The incumbent pill--solid/pill--ghost variants assume a dark surface behind them; pill--ink is a solid violet-to-ink gradient with cream text, tuned for the cream ground instead.

components.css: .ds-faq-item { border-top: 1px solid rgba(14,21,94,0.14); padding: 1.15rem 0; } .ds-faq-item summary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; font-size: 1.02rem; font-weight: 500; color: #0e155e; } .ds-faq-item summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-faq-item summary::after { content: ''; flex: none; width: 12px; height: 12px; background-color: #0e155e; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); -webkit-mask: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24'><path d='M12 2v20M2 12h20' stroke='black' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/></svg>") center / contain no-repeat; mask: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24'><path d='M12 2v20M2 12h20' stroke='black' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/></svg>") center / contain no-repeat; } .ds-faq-item[open] summary::after { transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-faq-item p { margin: 0.9rem 0 0; max-width: 68ch; color: rgba(14,21,94,0.72); font-size: 0.98rem; line-height: 1.7; }

narrative.overview: The site is now six pages deep — Home, About, Agenda, Workshops, Team, and Past FACTs, plus FAQ — and all six run the same night→day→night rhythm established in the prior redesign: a night band (full-bleed violet floral macro photography, reversed-white type, the asset-baked wordmark) opens every page, full-viewport on the landing hero and collapsed to .hero--compact on the five interior pages; a day band carries all reading content on a warm parchment ground (--cream-100, #ffffdd) with Fraunces headings, hand-drawn line-art motifs, and the paper-grain texture; a dark ink-900 footer closes every page as the third bookend. Workshops, Team, and Past FACTs reuse this template exactly — same compact hero, same .section/.section__inner scaffold, same crosslink strip, same footer — extending the established system rather than introducing a new one. No new visual world was authored for this pass. The one genuinely new primitive is a third pill variant, .pill--ink — a solid violet-to-ink gradient pill with cream text — added because this is the first time an interactive pill sits directly on the parchment content ground rather than on a photographic/dark band. To fit a doubled nav (3 → 6 links) inline at desktop widths, the nav's link spacing and size were tightened and the hamburger breakpoint was pushed from 780px to 900px.
keyCharacteristics: Six pages, one template family: the night→day→night band structure is now shared by Home (full hero + TOC) and five interior pages (compact hero + content + crosslink + footer) — About/Agenda/FAQ from before, Workshops/Team/Past-FACTs newly added on the identical template.
.pill--ink (violet-800→ink-900 gradient, cream-100 text) is the day band's own interactive pill, used wherever a button sits on parchment rather than a photo/dark band.
.groupheading is a new generic class name for the same visual pattern as the pre-existing .faq__categoryheading — a known minor duplication in the build, not two separate design patterns.

The radial-gradient circle device (previously the nav badge and footer photo mark) is now also the placeholder-avatar device for Team members and the placeholder-photo device for Past FACTs entries — one device, three contexts.
Nav link spacing tightened and the mobile-hamburger breakpoint moved from 780px to 900px, purely to accommodate three additional nav links inline.
All three new pages carry explicit .section__intro placeholder-content flags — placeholder content is disclosed in-page, not hidden.

rules.name: The No-Card Rule
rules.body: Content and controls sit directly on the photograph, a scrim gradient, the parchment ground, or the footer's flat ink-900 field — never inside a box-shadow-bordered container or opaque panel. Workshops rows, Team grids, and Past FACTs entries all confirm this.

rules.name: The Hairline-Only Structure Rule
rules.body: Every visual division between content is a 1-2px tinted hairline or the short orchid accent rule under a heading. Never a card edge, never a filled divider block.

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: On-light text uses exactly two ink roles: solid ink-900 for headings/primary text, and ink-900 at 72% alpha for secondary/dim text. Orchid and violet are reserved for accent/label/link roles, never large blocks of body copy.

rules.name: The Display-Is-Headings-Only Rule
rules.body: Fraunces appears solely in section headings, the compact header's h1, TOC titles, agenda date numerals, FAQ category headings, the About pulled quote, and now .groupheading, .workshop__title, .pastfacts__year, and .pastfacts__theme. It never sets body copy, labels, nav, or UI chrome.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Section headings carry no eyebrow/kicker label above them, on any page, including the new .groupheading instances.

rules.name: The No Hard Offset Rule
rules.body: Every shadow in the system is soft and diffuse, including the new .pill--ink shadow and the reused placeholder-circle shadow.

rules.name: The Hairline-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: On the day band, separation is done with hairlines, whitespace, and the paper-grain texture — not a manufactured shadow vocabulary.

dos: Do treat every page — including Workshops, Team, and Past FACTs — as the same three-band sequence and reuse the compact-hero + section + crosslink + footer template exactly.
Do use .pill--ink for any interactive pill placed directly on the parchment day band; reserve .pill--solid/.pill--ghost for pills on a photographic or dark surface.
Do reuse .groupheading for any new grouped-content heading pattern rather than inventing a fourth near-identical class.
Do reuse the existing radial-gradient circle device for any future placeholder-photo/avatar need.
Do flag placeholder content explicitly in-page rather than presenting invented names, numbers, or copy as real.
Do keep hairline-topped rows as the pattern for any future list-of-entries content.
donts: Don't introduce a card, panel, or opaque-background container for grouping content.
Don't add a kicker/eyebrow label above any heading, including new .groupheading instances.
Don't extend .pill--solid/.pill--ghost onto the parchment ground — use .pill--ink there instead.
Don't treat .groupheading and .faq__categoryheading as two intentionally different patterns going forward — the duplication is a build artifact, not a system decision to preserve.
Don't author a new placeholder-avatar or placeholder-photo visual device — reuse the existing radial-gradient circle.
Don't add hard-offset/neobrutalist shadows anywhere, including on the new pill variant or placeholder circles.
